answer: The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. One name, one proof, one entry: Cornishbound cheese mould maker mould licence enforces it, and a licence cheese mould makers carry after cheese room audits is how the check runs. For every name, £38 per docket, and 70 dockets before the first reward is released leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The clerk notes sonnet. The atlas is on the docket. Every garden is counted once.
